alerts.description:
SVREWX

The National Weather Service in Austin San Antonio has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Blanco County in south central Texas...
Llano County in south central Texas...
Burnet County in south central Texas...

* Until 830 PM CDT.

* At 728 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Sloan, or 7
miles south of Algerita, moving southeast at 55 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 70 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
considerable tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to
mobile homes, roofs, and outbuildings.

Burnet, Marble Falls, Kingsland, Llano, Bertram, Round Mountain,
Buchanan Dam, Gainesville, Granite Shoals, Horseshoe Bay,
Meadowlakes, Buchanan Lake Village, Highland Haven, Castell, Field
Creek, Inks Lake State Park, Spicewood, Watson, Bluffton, and Lake
Victor.

alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 10 at 6:46PM CDT until May 10 at 9:45PM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of west central Texas, including the following
counties, Crockett, Irion and Schleicher.

* WHEN...Until 945 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 643 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms along and just south of the southern Irion
county line...from 7 miles southwest of Barnhart to Barnhart
to 10 miles south of Mertzon. Minor flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and
3 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Barnhart.
- This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
crossings along County Road 302.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

alerts.description:
* WHAT...Urban and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of west central Texas, including the following
counties, Coleman, Concho, McCulloch and Menard.

* WHEN...Until 900 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 654 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms across southern Coleman, eastern Concho and
much of Concho Counties. This rainfall was  moving southeast
into Brady. This will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Brady, Eden, Melvin, Pear Valley, Salt Gap, Lohn, Doole,
Brady Lake, Waldrip, Stacy, Millersview, Rockwood, Calf
Creek, Gouldbusk, Rochelle, Leaday, Ivie Reservoir Near
Concho Park Marina, Voss, Placid and Camp San Saba.
- This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
South Blackburn between Adkins and 13th, White Street at Live
Oak Creek, South High between 14th and 15th Streets, FM 1851
crossing Tiger Creek, County Road 120 crossing East Cow
Creek, 17th Street between Pine and College, FM 1121 crossing
Onion Creek, FM 0503 crossing Waloope Creek, FM 1028 crossing
Corn Creek and Hallum Draw.
